BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing CI-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 11-G in the area bounded by

A line 228.18 feet south of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue; a line 60.00 feet east of and parallel to
North Clark Street; a line 223.18 feet south of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue; the alley next east and
parallel to North Clark Street; a line 291.18 south of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue; a line 60.00 feet
east of and parallel to North Clark Street; a line 286.18 feet south of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue;
and North Clark Street;



to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
